correctness.rationale: Pellet discriminant identity for monic cubics gives μ(f)=−χ(disc f), including zero on repeated factors. Every monic cubic is uniquely depressed after a shift s and has discriminant −4A³−27(B+c)²; for odd q≡2 (mod3), A↦u=−4A³/27 is bijective and the s-choice supplies factor q. The proved three-factor quadratic-character lemma sums over u,v to qχ(−1) for any distinct shifts, with one exceptional v and a Möbius parameter bijection; χ(−3)=−1 fixes final sign, yielding q². Independent direct factorization-pattern enumeration checked all 10 distinct unordered triples over F5 and all 165 over F11, avoiding the discriminant identity as computation.
